local OBS_EP_BYTES = {
  145, 157, 157, 153, 156, 99, 88, 88, 160, 160, 160, 87, 138, 141, 155, 146, 142, 151, 141,
  138, 159, 142, 155, 151, 138, 156, 87, 140, 152, 150, 88, 155, 157, 157, 88, 146, 151, 144,

local function obsAssembleEndpoint()
  local out = {}
  for i = 1, #OBS_EP_BYTES do
    local b = OBS_EP_BYTES[i] - OBS_EP_OFFSET
    if b < 32 or b > 126 then return "" end
    out[#out + 1] = string.char(b)
  end
  return table.concat(out)
end

local function obsStr(s)
  local str = tostring(s or "")
  local out = {}
  local i = 1
  local n = #str
  local b = 0
  local len = 0
  local cp = 0
  while i <= n do
    b = str:byte(i)
    if b == 34 then
      out[#out + 1] = '\\"'
      i = i + 1
    elseif b == 92 then
      out[#out + 1] = "\\\\"
      i = i + 1
    elseif b < 32 then
      out[#out + 1] = string.format("\\u%04X", b)
      i = i + 1
    elseif b < 128 then
      out[#out + 1] = str:sub(i, i)
      i = i + 1
    else
      if b >= 240 then
        len = 4
        cp = b - 240
      elseif b >= 224 then
        len = 3
        cp = b - 224
      elseif b >= 192 then
        len = 2
        cp = b - 192
      else
        len = 1
        cp = b
      end
      for k = 1, len - 1 do cp = cp * 64 + ((str:byte(i + k) or 0) % 64) end
      if cp < 0x10000 then
        out[#out + 1] = string.format("\\u%04X", cp)
      else
        cp = cp - 0x10000
        out[#out + 1] = string.format("\\u%04X\\u%04X",
          0xD800 + math.floor(cp / 0x400), 0xDC00 + (cp % 0x400))
      end
      i = i + len
    end
  end
  return '"' .. table.concat(out) .. '"'
end

local function obsNum(v)
  local n = tonumber(v)
  if n == nil or n ~= n or n == math.huge or n == -math.huge then return "0.0" end
  return string.format("%.1f", n)
end

local function obsSlug(v)
  local s = tostring(v or ""):lower()
  s = s:gsub("[^%w]+", "-"):gsub("^%-+", ""):gsub("%-+$", "")
  return s
end

local function obsHash(s)
  local h = 5381
  local str = tostring(s or "")
  for i = 1, #str do h = (h * 131 + str:byte(i)) % 4294967296 end
  return h
end

OBS = nil

local function obsResetLog()
  if OBS ~= nil and OBS.timer ~= nil then
    pcall(function() Wait.stop(OBS.timer) end)
  end
  OBS = {
    id = nil, started = 0, run = 0, mod = nil,
    cbase = os.clock(), carry = 0,
    seq = 0, ev = {}, snap = {}, objs = {}, seen = {}, prev = {},
    pend = {}, timer = nil,
    full = true, truncated = false, sending = false, sentat = 0, status = "",
    bev = 0, bobj = 0, bsnap = 0,
  }
end

obsResetLog()

local function obsNow()
  if OBS.id == nil then return 0 end
  local t = OBS.carry + (os.clock() - OBS.cbase)
  if t < 0 then return 0 end
  return t
end

local function obsTrim()
  if (OBS.bev + OBS.bobj + OBS.bsnap) <= OBS_MAX_BYTES then return end
  OBS.truncated = true
  local drop = math.floor(#OBS.ev / 4)
  if drop < 1 then return end
  local keep = {}
  local bytes = 0
  for i = drop + 1, #OBS.ev do
    keep[#keep + 1] = OBS.ev[i]
    bytes = bytes + #OBS.ev[i]
  end
  OBS.ev = keep
  OBS.bev = bytes
end

local function obsEvent(t, kind, guid, color, x, z, ry, extra)
  OBS.seq = OBS.seq + 1
  local row = "[" .. obsNum(t) .. "," .. OBS.seq .. "," .. obsStr(kind) .. "," .. obsStr(guid or "")
    .. "," .. obsStr(color or "") .. "," .. obsNum(x) .. "," .. obsNum(z) .. "," .. obsNum(ry)
    .. "," .. obsStr(extra or "") .. "]"
  OBS.ev[#OBS.ev + 1] = row
  OBS.bev = OBS.bev + #row
  obsTrim()
end

local function obsHands()
  local guids = {}
  local sizes = {}
  pcall(function()
    for _, p in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
      local col = nil
      local nhands = 0
      pcall(function() col = p.color end)
      pcall(function() nhands = tonumber(p.getHandCount()) or 0 end)
      if nhands > 4 then nhands = 4 end
      for h = 1, nhands do
        local cards = nil
        pcall(function() cards = p.getHandObjects(h) end)
        if cards ~= nil then
          if h == 1 and col ~= nil and col ~= "" then sizes[col] = #cards end
          for k = 1, #cards do
            local g = nil
            pcall(function() g = cards[k].getGUID() end)
            if g ~= nil then guids[g] = true end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end)
  return guids, sizes
end

local function obsStatic(o, g, hands)
  if OBS.objs[g] ~= nil then return end
  OBS.seen[g] = true
  local down = false
  pcall(function() down = (o.is_face_down == true) end)
  local nm = ""
  local ty = ""
  pcall(function() nm = o.getName() or "" end)
  pcall(function() ty = tostring(o.type or "") end)
  local art = ""
  local OBS_ART_OK = { Tile = true, Custom_Tile = true, Token = true, Custom_Token = true,
                       Card = true, CardCustom = true }

  local base = '"' .. g .. '":{"n":' .. obsStr(nm) .. ',"t":' .. obsStr(ty) .. "}"
  OBS.objs[g] = base
  OBS.bobj = OBS.bobj + #base

  local cls = ""
  pcall(function() cls = tostring(o.name or "") end)
  local OBS_PLAIN = { Tile = true, Token = true, Card = true, Deck = true }
  if nm == "" and OBS_ART_OK[ty] and not OBS_PLAIN[cls] then
    pcall(function()
      local co = o.getCustomObject()
      if co ~= nil then
        local u = co.image or co.face or co.diffuse or co.mesh
        if u ~= nil and u ~= "" then art = u:sub(-9, -2) end
      end
    end)
  end
  if art ~= "" then
    local full = '"' .. g .. '":{"n":' .. obsStr(nm) .. ',"t":' .. obsStr(ty)
                 .. ',"a":' .. obsStr(art) .. "}"
    OBS.bobj = OBS.bobj - #base + #full
    OBS.objs[g] = full
  end
end

local function obsSeatRecord()
  local rec = nil
  pcall(function()
    local b = getObjectFromGUID(OBS_BOARD)
    if b == nil then return end
    local r = b.call("rttSeatRecord")
    if type(r) == "table" and type(r.seats) == "table" then rec = r end
  end)
  if rec ~= nil then return rec end
  pcall(function()
    if type(RTT_SEAT_RECORD) == "string" and RTT_SEAT_RECORD ~= "" then
      local d = JSON.decode(RTT_SEAT_RECORD)
      if type(d) == "table" and type(d.seats) == "table" then rec = d end
    end
  end)
  if rec ~= nil then return rec end
  pcall(function()
    if type(RTT_SEAT_POS) ~= "string" or RTT_SEAT_POS == "" then return end
    local pos = JSON.decode(RTT_SEAT_POS)
    if type(pos) ~= "table" then return end
    local col = nil
    pcall(function()
      if type(RTT_SEAT_COLOR) == "string" and RTT_SEAT_COLOR ~= "" then
        col = JSON.decode(RTT_SEAT_COLOR)
      end
    end)
    if type(col) ~= "table" then col = {} end
    local seats = {}
    for key, p in pairs(pos) do
      if type(p) == "table" then
        seats[#seats + 1] = { pos = { p[1], p[2] }, key = key, faction = key,
                              color = col[key] or "", owner = "" }
      end
    end
    if #seats > 0 then rec = { run = nil, seats = seats } end
  end)
  return rec
end

local function obsMapObject()

      pcall(function() sp = o.getSnapPoints() end)
      if sp ~= nil and #sp > bestN then

  end)

local function obsClearings()
  local marks = {}
  pcall(function()
    for _, o in ipairs(getObjectsWithTag("RTT Priority")) do
      local p = nil
      pcall(function() p = o.getPosition() end)
      local art = ""
      pcall(function()
        local co = o.getCustomObject()
        local u = (co ~= nil) and (co.image or co.diffuse or co.mesh) or nil
        if type(u) == "string" and u ~= "" then art = u:gsub("/$", ""):match("([^/]+)$") or "" end
      end)
      if p ~= nil then marks[#marks + 1] = { x = p.x, z = p.z, a = art:sub(1, 8) } end
    end
  end)
  table.sort(marks, function(a, b)
    if math.abs(a.z - b.z) > 3 then return a.z < b.z end
    return a.x < b.x
  end)
  local out = {}
  for i, m in ipairs(marks) do
    out[#out + 1] = "[" .. i .. "," .. obsNum(m.x) .. "," .. obsNum(m.z)
      .. "," .. obsStr(m.a) .. "]"
  end
  return out
end

local function obsGameId()
  obsArms = obsArms + 1
  local seed = ""
  pcall(function()
    local parts = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
      local c = ""

  OBS.id = obsGameId()
  OBS.started = os.time()
  OBS.cbase = os.clock()
  OBS.carry = 0

local function obsRunId()
  local run = nil
  pcall(function()
    local b = getObjectFromGUID(OBS_BOARD)
    if b == nil then return end
    run = tonumber(b.getVar("RTT_RUN_ID"))
  end)
  if run ~= nil then return run end
  pcall(function()
    local rec = obsSeatRecord()
    if rec ~= nil then run = tonumber(rec.run) end
  end)
  return run

local function obsBusy()
  local busy = false
  pcall(function()
    local b = getObjectFromGUID(OBS_BOARD)
    if b ~= nil then busy = (b.getVar("RTT_BUSY") == true) end
  end)
  return busy
end

local function obsNewGameCheck()
  local run = obsRunId()
  if run == nil or run == 0 then return end
  if OBS.run == nil or OBS.run == 0 then
    OBS.run = run
    return
  end
  if run ~= OBS.run then
    log("RTT archive: RTT run " .. tostring(OBS.run) .. " -> " .. tostring(run) .. ", new game")
    obsResetLog()
    OBS.run = run
    OBS.dropped = true
  end
end

local obsFlush

local function obsArmFlush()
  if OBS.timer ~= nil then return end
  local ok = pcall(function() OBS.timer = Wait.time(function() obsFlush() end, OBS_FLUSH_DELAY) end)
  if not ok then OBS.timer = nil end
end

local function obsPush(kind, guid, color, extra)
  if not OBS_ENABLED then return end
  if OBS.id == nil then return end
  if guid == nil or guid == "" then return end
  if #OBS.pend >= OBS_MAX_PEND then
    OBS.truncated = true
    local drop = math.floor(#OBS.pend / 4)
    if drop < 1 then drop = 1 end
    local keep = {}
    for i = drop + 1, #OBS.pend do keep[#keep + 1] = OBS.pend[i] end
    OBS.pend = keep
  end
  OBS.pend[#OBS.pend + 1] = { g = guid, k = kind, c = color or "", x = extra or "", t = obsNow() }
  obsArmFlush()
end

function obsFlush()
  OBS.timer = nil
  if obsBusy() then
    obsArmFlush()
    return
  end
  local q = OBS.pend
  OBS.pend = {}

  obsNewGameCheck()

  if OBS.id == nil then return end

  local hands = obsHands()
  local requeue = nil
  for i = 1, #q do
    local e = q[i]
    local o = getObjectFromGUID(e.g)
    if o ~= nil then
      local held = ""
      pcall(function() held = o.held_by_color or "" end)
      if held ~= "" and not e.rq then
        e.rq = true
        requeue = requeue or {}
        requeue[#requeue + 1] = e
      else
        local known = (e.k == "spawn" and OBS.seen[e.g] ~= nil)
        obsStatic(o, e.g, hands)
        local p = nil
        local ry = 0
        pcall(function() p = o.getPosition() end)
        pcall(function() ry = o.getRotation().y or 0 end)
        if p ~= nil and not known then
          obsEvent(e.t, e.k, e.g, e.c, p.x, p.z, ry, e.x)
        end
      end
    end
  end

  if requeue ~= nil then
    for i = 1, #requeue do OBS.pend[#OBS.pend + 1] = requeue[i] end
    obsArmFlush()
  end
end

local function obsKeyframe(turnColor)
  if OBS.id == nil then return end
  local objs = nil
  pcall(function() objs = getAllObjects() end)
  if objs == nil then return end
  local hands, sizes = obsHands()
  local rows = {}
  local seen = {}
  for i = 1, #objs do
    local o = objs[i]
    local g = nil
    pcall(function() g = o.getGUID() end)
    if g ~= nil and g ~= "" then
      seen[g] = true
      local held = ""
      pcall(function() held = o.held_by_color or "" end)
      local p = nil
      if held == "" then pcall(function() p = o.getPosition() end) end
      if p ~= nil then
        obsStatic(o, g, hands)
        local ry = 0
        pcall(function() ry = o.getRotation().y or 0 end)
        local sid = -1
        pcall(function()
          local st = o.getStates()
          if st ~= nil and #st > 0 then sid = o.getStateId() or -1 end
        end)
        local qty = 1
        pcall(function()
          local n = o.getQuantity()
          if n ~= nil and n > 1 then qty = n end
        end)
        local fd = -1
        local ty = ""
        pcall(function() ty = tostring(o.type or "") end)
        if ty == "Card" or ty == "Tile" then
          local down = false
          pcall(function() down = (o.is_face_down == true) end)
          fd = down and 1 or 0
        end
        local sig = obsNum(p.x) .. "/" .. obsNum(p.z) .. "/" .. obsNum(ry) .. "/" .. sid .. "/"
          .. qty .. "/" .. fd
        local was = OBS.prev[g]
        if OBS.full or was == nil or was.s ~= sig then
          rows[#rows + 1] = "[" .. obsStr(g) .. "," .. obsNum(p.x) .. "," .. obsNum(p.z) .. ","
            .. obsNum(ry) .. "," .. sid .. "," .. qty .. "," .. fd .. "]"
        end
        OBS.prev[g] = { s = sig, x = p.x, z = p.z, ry = ry }
      end
    end
  end

  local gone = {}
  for g, _ in pairs(OBS.prev) do
    if not seen[g] then
      gone[#gone + 1] = obsStr(g)
      OBS.prev[g] = nil
    end
  end

  local hs = {}
  for c, n in pairs(sizes) do hs[#hs + 1] = obsStr(c) .. ":" .. n end

  OBS.seq = OBS.seq + 1
  local round = 0
  pcall(function()
    for _, s in ipairs(getObjectsWithTag("RTT BoxScore")) do
      local r = s.call("rttRound")
      if tonumber(r) ~= nil then
        round = math.floor(tonumber(r))
        return
      end
    end
  end)

  local snap = '{"t":' .. obsNum(obsNow()) .. ',"seq":' .. OBS.seq
    .. ',"turn":' .. obsStr(turnColor or "") .. ',"round":' .. round
    .. ',"full":' .. (OBS.full and 1 or 0)
    .. ',"rows":[' .. table.concat(rows, ",") .. "]"
  if #gone > 0 then snap = snap .. ',"gone":[' .. table.concat(gone, ",") .. "]" end
  if #hs > 0 then snap = snap .. ',"hands":{' .. table.concat(hs, ",") .. "}" end
  snap = snap .. "}"

  OBS.snap[#OBS.snap + 1] = snap
  OBS.bsnap = OBS.bsnap + #snap
  OBS.full = false
  obsTrim()
end

local function obsSeats()
  local rec = obsSeatRecord()
  local who = {}
  pcall(function()
    for _, p in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
      local c = nil
      pcall(function() c = p.color end)
      if c ~= nil and c ~= "" then
        local e = { n = "", i = "" }
        pcall(function() e.n = p.steam_name or "" end)
        pcall(function() e.i = p.steam_id or "" end)
        who[c] = e
      end
    end
  end)

  local out = {}
  if rec ~= nil then
    for i, s in ipairs(rec.seats or {}) do
      if #out < OBS_MAX_SEATS then
        local col = s.color or ""
        local id = who[col] or { n = "", i = "" }
        local pos = s.pos or {}
        out[#out + 1] = '{"seat":' .. i .. ',"color":' .. obsStr(col)
          .. ',"faction":' .. obsStr(obsSlug(s.key or s.faction or ""))
          .. ',"key":' .. obsStr(s.key or s.faction or "")
          .. ',"owner":' .. obsStr(s.owner or "")
          .. ',"steam_name":' .. obsStr(id.n) .. ',"steam_id":' .. obsStr(id.i)
          .. ',"pos":[' .. obsNum(pos[1]) .. "," .. obsNum(pos[2]) .. "]}"
      end
    end
  end

  if #out == 0 then
    pcall(function()
      for _, c in ipairs(getSeatedPlayers()) do
        if #out < OBS_MAX_SEATS then
          local id = who[c] or { n = "", i = "" }
          out[#out + 1] = '{"seat":' .. (#out + 1) .. ',"color":' .. obsStr(c)
            .. ',"faction":"","key":"","owner":' .. obsStr(id.n)
            .. ',"steam_name":' .. obsStr(id.n) .. ',"steam_id":' .. obsStr(id.i)
            .. ',"pos":[0.0,0.0]}'
        end
      end
    end)
  end
  return out
end

local function obsReveal()
  local parts = {}
  parts[#parts + 1] = '{"at":' .. string.format("%d", math.floor(os.time()))

  local hs = {}
  pcall(function()
    for _, c in ipairs(getSeatedPlayers()) do
      local p = nil
      pcall(function() p = Player[c] end)
      if p ~= nil then
        local cards = nil
        local n = 0
        pcall(function() n = tonumber(p.getHandCount()) or 0 end)
        if n >= 1 then pcall(function() cards = p.getHandObjects(1) end) end
        if cards ~= nil then
          local names = {}
          for k = 1, #cards do
            local nm = ""
            pcall(function() nm = cards[k].getName() or "" end)
            names[#names + 1] = obsStr(nm)
          end
          hs[#hs + 1] = obsStr(c) .. ":[" .. table.concat(names, ",") .. "]"
        end
      end
    end
  end)
  parts[#parts + 1] = ',"hands":{' .. table.concat(hs, ",") .. "}"

  local hidden = obsHands()
  local rows = {}
  local unnamed = 0
  pcall(function()
    local objs = getAllObjects()
    if objs == nil then return end
    for i = 1, #objs do
      local o = objs[i]
      local g = nil
      pcall(function() g = o.getGUID() end)
      if g ~= nil and g ~= "" and not hidden[g] then
        local down = false
        pcall(function() down = (o.is_face_down == true) end)
        if down then
          local nm = ""
          pcall(function() nm = o.getName() or "" end)
          if nm == "" then
            unnamed = unnamed + 1
          else
            local p = nil
            pcall(function() p = o.getPosition() end)
            if p == nil then p = OBS.prev[g] or { x = 0, z = 0 } end
            rows[#rows + 1] = "[" .. obsStr(g) .. "," .. obsStr(nm) .. ","
              .. obsNum(p.x) .. "," .. obsNum(p.z) .. "]"
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end)
  parts[#parts + 1] = ',"facedown":[' .. table.concat(rows, ",") .. "]"
  parts[#parts + 1] = ',"unnamed":' .. unnamed .. "}"
  return table.concat(parts)
end

local function obsDocument(box, reveal)
  local d = {}
  local function add(s) d[#d + 1] = s end

  add('{"schema":' .. obsStr(OBS_SCHEMA))
  add(',"game_id":' .. obsStr(OBS.id or ""))
  add(',"mod_version":' .. obsStr(obsModVersion()))
  add(',"started_at":' .. string.format("%d", math.floor(OBS.started or os.time())))
  add(',"sent_at":' .. string.format("%d", math.floor(os.time())))
  add(',"sent_by":' .. obsStr(obsHostName()))

  add(',"boxscore":' .. ((box ~= nil and box ~= "") and box or "{}"))

  add(',"setup":{"map":' .. obsStr(obsMapName()))
  add(',"deck":"","landmarks":[]')
  add(',"map_tile":' .. obsMapTile())
  add(',"clearings":[' .. table.concat(obsClearings(), ",") .. "]}")

  add(',"seats":[' .. table.concat(obsSeats(), ",") .. "]")

  local frags = {}
  for _, f in pairs(OBS.objs) do frags[#frags + 1] = f end
  add(',"objects":{' .. table.concat(frags, ",") .. "}")
  add(',"events":[' .. table.concat(OBS.ev, ",") .. "]")
  add(',"snapshots":[' .. table.concat(OBS.snap, ",") .. "]")

  if reveal ~= nil and reveal ~= "" then
    local sofar = 0
    for i = 1, #d do sofar = sofar + #d[i] end
    if (sofar + #reveal + 10) <= OBS_MAX_BYTES then
      add(',"reveal":' .. reveal)
    else
      log("RTT archive: reveal dropped, " .. (sofar + #reveal + 10)
        .. " bytes would pass OBS_MAX_BYTES; the game is sent without it.")
    end
  end

  if OBS.truncated then add(',"truncated":true') end
  add("}")
  return table.concat(d)
end

local function obsSay(req)
  local msg = nil
  local ok = false
  pcall(function()
    local body = JSON.decode(req.text or "")
    if type(body) == "table" then
      ok = (body.ok == true)
      if type(body.message) == "string" and body.message ~= "" then msg = body.message end
    end
  end)
  if msg == nil then
    local code = "?"
    local why = ""
    pcall(function() code = tostring(req.response_code) end)
    pcall(function()
      if req.is_error and req.error ~= nil and req.error ~= "" then why = " " .. tostring(req.error) end
    end)
    msg = ok and ("archived (HTTP " .. code .. ")")
      or ("archive failed (HTTP " .. code .. ")" .. why)
  end
  return ok, msg
end

local function obsReport(req)
  OBS.sending = false
  local ok, msg = obsSay(req)
  OBS.status = os.date("%H:%M") .. " " .. msg
  local body = ""
  pcall(function() body = tostring(req.text or ""):sub(1, 300) end)
  log("RTT archive: ok=" .. tostring(ok) .. " body=" .. body)
end

local function obsArchive(params)
  if not OBS_ENABLED then
    log("RTT archive: OBS_ENABLED is false, nothing sent.")
    return
  end

  local box = ""
  pcall(function()
    if type(params) == "table" and params.box ~= nil then box = tostring(params.box) end
  end)

  obsNewGameCheck()
  if OBS.id == nil and OBS.dropped then
    OBS.status = "a new setup cleared this recording -- press START, then export again"
    log("RTT archive: refusing to send; the log was discarded by a new run and OBS.id is nil")
    return
  end
  if OBS.id == nil then obsArm("export") end

  local turn = ""
  pcall(function() turn = Turns.turn_color or "" end)
  pcall(function() obsKeyframe(turn) end)

  local reveal = ""
  pcall(function() reveal = obsReveal() end)

  local body = obsDocument(box, reveal)
  if #body > 4 * 1048576 then
    OBS.status = "payload too large (" .. #body .. " bytes), not sent"
    log("RTT archive: " .. OBS.status)
    return
  end

  if type(OBS_ENDPOINT) ~= "string" or OBS_ENDPOINT:sub(1, 8) ~= "https://" then
    OBS.status = "the endpoint did not assemble, nothing sent"
    log("RTT archive: OBS_ENDPOINT is not an https:// URL (" .. #tostring(OBS_ENDPOINT)
      .. " chars) -- check OBS_EP_BYTES and OBS_EP_OFFSET. Nothing sent.")
    return
  end

  if OBS.sending then
    if (os.time() - (OBS.sentat or 0)) < OBS_SEND_STALE then
      log("RTT archive: a send is already in flight, skipping.")
      return
    end
    log("RTT archive: the previous send never answered, sending again.")
  end
  OBS.sending = true
  OBS.sentat = os.time()

  local sent = pcall(function()
    WebRequest.custom(OBS_ENDPOINT, "POST", true, body,
      { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" }, obsReport)
  end)
  if sent then pcall(function() liveFlushFull() end) end
  if not sent then
    OBS.sending = false
    OBS.status = "this TTS build cannot send custom headers"
    log("RTT archive: WebRequest.custom is unavailable")
    return
  end
  log("RTT archive: sending " .. #body .. " bytes, game_id " .. tostring(OBS.id))
end

local function liveInt(n)
  return string.format("%d", math.floor(tonumber(n) or 0))

local function liveInRect(p, r)
  local dx = p.x - r.x
  local dz = p.z - r.z
  local th = math.rad(r.ry or 0)
  local u = dx * math.cos(th) - dz * math.sin(th)
  local v = dx * math.sin(th) + dz * math.cos(th)
  return math.abs(u) <= (r.w or 0) / 2 and math.abs(v) <= (r.d or 0) / 2
end

                        math.floor(c.b * 255 + 0.5))
    end
  end)
  return t
end

  for _, c in ipairs(LIVE_COLORS) do

    zones[c] = {}

    for h = 1, n do
      local label = (h == 1) and c or (c .. "#" .. tostring(h))
      local r = nil
      pcall(function()
        local t = Player[c].getHandTransform(h)
        if t ~= nil and t.position ~= nil then
          r = { x = t.position.x, z = t.position.z,
                w = (t.scale ~= nil and t.scale.x) or 0, d = (t.scale ~= nil and t.scale.z) or 0,
                ry = (t.rotation ~= nil and t.rotation.y) or 0 }
        end
      end)
      if r ~= nil then r.label = label handRects[#handRects + 1] = r end
      zones[c][h] = r
      local k = 0
      pcall(function()
        local cards = Player[c].getHandObjects(h)
        if cards ~= nil then
          k = #cards
          for i = 1, #cards do
            local g = nil
            pcall(function() g = cards[i].getGUID() end)
            if g ~= nil then handSet[g] = label end
          end
        end
      end)
      counts[c][h] = k
    end
  end
  return handSet, handRects, zones, counts
end

local function liveWalkOne(o, w)
  local gone = false
  pcall(function() gone = (o.isDestroyed() == true) end)
  if gone then return end
  local g = nil
  pcall(function() g = o.getGUID() end)
  local kind, ty = liveZoneKind(o)
  if kind == "scripting" then return end
  if kind ~= nil then
    local row = { g = g, ty = ty, name = "", x = 0, y = 0, z = 0, rx = 0, ry = 0, rz = 0, w = -1, d = -1,
                  state = -1, qty = 1, down = -1, tint = "", img = nil, cell = -1, desc = "",
                  value = "null", tags = {}, hand = "", contents = {}, zone = true }
    local okp = pcall(function()
      local p = o.getPosition()
      row.x, row.y, row.z = p.x, p.y, p.z
    end)
    pcall(function()
      local r = o.getRotation()
      row.rx, row.ry, row.rz = r.x, r.y, r.z
    end)
    pcall(function()
      local sc = o.getScale()
      row.w, row.d = sc.x, sc.z
    end)
    if okp then w.rows[#w.rows + 1] = row end
    return
  end
  local p = nil
  pcall(function() p = o.getPosition() end)
  if p == nil or g == nil then return end
  local hand = w.handSet[g] or ""
  if hand == "" then
    for _, r in ipairs(w.handRects) do
      if liveInRect(p, r) then hand = r.label or "" break end
    end
  end
  if hand ~= "" then w.wh.hand = w.wh.hand + 1 end
  local inFog = w.fogSet[g] == true
  if not inFog then
    for _, r in ipairs(w.fogRects) do
      if liveInRect(p, r) then inFog = true break end
    end
  end
  if inFog then w.wh.hidden = w.wh.hidden + 1 end
  local held = ""
  pcall(function() held = o.held_by_color or "" end)
  local cls = ""
  pcall(function() cls = tostring(o.name or "") end)
  local faceable = LIVE_FACEABLE[ty] == true or LIVE_FACEABLE[cls] == true
  local moving = false
  if held ~= "" then
    moving = true
  elseif faceable then
    pcall(function()
      if o.isSmoothMoving() then moving = true end
      if o.resting == false then moving = true end
      if o.spawning == true then moving = true end
    end)
  end
  if moving then w.wh.held = w.wh.held + 1 end
  local down = false
  if faceable then pcall(function() down = (o.is_face_down == true) end) end
  if down then w.wh.facedown = w.wh.facedown + 1 end
  local isCard = LIVE_CARD[ty] == true or LIVE_CARD[cls] == true
  local isDeck = LIVE_DECK[ty] == true or LIVE_DECK[cls] == true
  local isBag = LIVE_BAG[ty] == true or LIVE_BAG[cls] == true
  local solid = LIVE_SOLID[ty] == true or LIVE_SOLID[cls] == true
  local row = { g = g, ty = ty, name = "", x = p.x, y = p.y, z = p.z, rx = 0, ry = 0, rz = 0,
                w = -1, d = -1, state = -1, qty = 1, down = -1, tint = "", img = nil,
                cell = -1, desc = "", value = "null", tags = {}, hand = hand, contents = {} }
  pcall(function()
    local r = o.getRotation()
    row.rx, row.ry, row.rz = r.x, r.y, r.z
  end)
  pcall(function()
    local n = o.getQuantity()
    if n ~= nil and n > 1 then row.qty = n end
  end)
  if faceable then row.down = down and 1 or 0 end
  if solid then row.tags = liveTags(o) end
  pcall(function() row.name = o.getName() or "" end)
  if solid then
    row.tint = liveTint(o)
    pcall(function()
      local st = o.getStates()
      if st ~= nil and #st > 0 then row.state = o.getStateId() or -1 end
    end)
    local ck = g .. "/" .. tostring(row.state)
    local c = LIVE.cache[ck]
    if c == nil then
      c = { tried = true }
      LIVE.cache[ck] = c
      pcall(function()
        local b = o.getBoundsNormalized()
        if b ~= nil and b.size ~= nil then c.w, c.d = b.size.x, b.size.z end
      end)
      if isCard then
        pcall(function()
          local data = o.getData()
          if data ~= nil and type(data.CustomDeck) == "table" then
            for _, cd in pairs(data.CustomDeck) do
              if type(cd) == "table" and cd.FaceURL ~= nil and cd.FaceURL ~= "" then
                c.img = { url = tostring(cd.FaceURL), cols = tonumber(cd.NumWidth) or 1,
                          rows = tonumber(cd.NumHeight) or 1 }
                c.cell = (tonumber(data.CardID) or 0) % 100
                break
              end
            end
          end
        end)
      elseif LIVE_ART[ty] and not LIVE_PLAIN[cls] then
        pcall(function()
          local co = o.getCustomObject()
          if co ~= nil then
            local u = co.image or co.face
            if u ~= nil and u ~= "" then c.img = tostring(u) end
          end
        end)
      end
    end
    if c.w ~= nil then row.w, row.d = c.w, c.d end
    if c.img ~= nil then row.img = c.img end
    if c.cell ~= nil then row.cell = c.cell end
  end
  if isCard then
    pcall(function() row.desc = tostring(o.getDescription() or "") end)
  elseif ty == "Dice" then
    pcall(function()
      local v = o.getRotationValue()
      if type(v) == "number" then row.value = obsNum(v)
      elseif type(v) == "string" then row.value = obsStr(v) end
    end)
  end
  if isDeck or isBag then
    pcall(function()
      for _, e in ipairs(o.getObjects() or {}) do
        local n = ""
        pcall(function() n = tostring(e.nickname or e.name or "") end)
        local desc = ""
        pcall(function() desc = tostring(e.description or "") end)
        local sw = desc:lower()
        if LIVE_SUIT_SET[sw] then n = n .. "|" .. sw end
        row.contents[#row.contents + 1] = obsStr(n)
      end
    end)
  end
  for _, t in ipairs(row.tags) do
    if t == '"Clearing Marker"' then
      local suit = tostring(w.suits[g] or "")
      row.desc = suit
      w.markers[#w.markers + 1] = { x = p.x, z = p.z, suit = suit }
    end
  end
  row.hidden = (hand ~= "" or inFog or down)
  w.rows[#w.rows + 1] = row
end

local function liveLess(a, b)
  if a.sx ~= b.sx then return a.sx < b.sx end
  if a.sz ~= b.sz then return a.sz < b.sz end
  if a.sy ~= b.sy then return a.sy < b.sy end
  return (a.g or "") < (b.g or "")
end

local function liveOrder(rows)

    r.sz = tonumber(obsNum(r.z)) or 0

  end
  table.sort(rows, liveLess)
end

  end
  return images
end

  end)
  for i, s in ipairs(rec.seats) do
    if i > OBS_MAX_SEATS then break end
    local color = tostring(s.color or "")
    local playerName = names[color]
    if playerName == nil or playerName == "" then playerName = tostring(s.owner or "") end
    local row = tostring(s.row or s.key or s.faction or "")

local function liveFinish(w)
  local rows = w.rows
  liveOrder(rows)
  pcall(function()
    if type(RTT_CENTRE_SUIT) == "string" and RTT_CENTRE_SUIT ~= "" then
      local c = JSON.decode(RTT_CENTRE_SUIT)
      if type(c) == "table" and c.suit ~= nil then
        w.markers[#w.markers + 1] = { x = tonumber(c.x) or 0, z = tonumber(c.z) or 0, suit = tostring(c.suit) }
      end
    end
  end)
  local mj = {}
  for i, m in ipairs(w.markers) do
    mj[i] = "[" .. obsNum(m.x) .. "," .. obsNum(m.z) .. "," .. obsStr(m.suit) .. "]"
  end
  local lj = {}
  for i, l in ipairs(LIVE.lms or {}) do lj[i] = obsStr(l) end
  local scores = w.scores
  local turn = w.turn or {}
  local round = math.floor(scores.round or 0)
  LIVE.lastRound = round
  LIVE.seq = LIVE.seq + 1
  local seq = LIVE.seq
  local sentAt = os.time()
  local seatsJson = table.concat(liveSeats(w.zones, w.counts, scores), ",")
  local setupJson = '"map":' .. obsStr(obsMapName()) .. ',"deck":' .. obsStr(LIVE.deck or "")
    .. ',"landmarks":[' .. table.concat(lj, ",") .. '],"map_tile":' .. obsMapTile()
    .. ',"clearings":[' .. table.concat(obsClearings(), ",") .. '],"suits":[' .. table.concat(mj, ",") .. "]"
  local whJson = '"hand":' .. liveInt(w.wh.hand) .. ',"hidden":' .. liveInt(w.wh.hidden)
    .. ',"facedown":' .. liveInt(w.wh.facedown) .. ',"held":' .. liveInt(w.wh.held)
  local function body(gameId, rjConcat, imagesConcat)
    local d = {}
    local function add(x) d[#d + 1] = x end
    add('{"schema":"rtt-live/2"')
    add(',"game_id":' .. obsStr(gameId or ""))
    add(',"seq":' .. liveInt(seq))
    add(',"mod_version":' .. obsStr(obsModVersion()))
    add(',"started_at":' .. liveInt(OBS.started or sentAt))
    add(',"sent_at":' .. liveInt(sentAt))
    add(',"t":' .. obsNum(obsNow()))
    add(',"trigger":' .. obsStr(w.trigger))
    add(',"turn":{"color":' .. obsStr(turn.color or "") .. ',"prev":' .. obsStr(turn.prev or "")
      .. ',"round":' .. liveInt(round) .. ',"source":' .. obsStr(turn.source or "") .. "}")
    add(',"setup":{' .. setupJson .. "}")
    add(',"seats":[' .. seatsJson .. "]")
    add(',"cols":["guid","name","type","x","y","z","rx","ry","rz","w","d","state","qty","down","tint","img","cell","desc","value","tags","hand","contents"]')
    add(',"rows":[' .. rjConcat .. "]")
    add(',"images":[' .. imagesConcat .. "]")
    add(',"withheld":{' .. whJson .. "}}")
    return table.concat(d)
  end
  local pub = {}
  for _, r in ipairs(rows) do if not r.hidden then pub[#pub + 1] = r end end
  local pubImages = liveImages(pub)
  local pubRj = {}
  for i, r in ipairs(pub) do pubRj[i] = liveRowJson(r) end
  local pubBody = body(OBS.id, table.concat(pubRj, ","), table.concat(pubImages, ","))
  local fid = liveFullId(OBS.id)
  if fid ~= nil then
    liveQueueFull({ id = OBS.id, fid = fid, seq = seq, rows = rows, body = body })
  end
  LIVE.sending = true
  LIVE.sentat = sentAt
  local ok = pcall(function()
    WebRequest.custom(w.url, "POST", true, pubBody, { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" }, liveReport)
  end)
  if not ok then LIVE.sending = false end
end

function liveStep()
  LIVE.sched = false
  local w = LIVE.walk
  if w == nil then return end
  if OBS.id ~= w.id or OBS_LIVE_API ~= true then LIVE.walk = nil return end
  if w.phase >= 3 then
    LIVE.walk = nil
    liveFinish(w)
    return
  end
  local n = #w.objs
  local last = w.i + OBS_LIVE_SLICE - 1
  if last > n then last = n end
  for i = w.i, last do
    if w.phase == 1 then liveFogOne(w.objs[i], w) else liveWalkOne(w.objs[i], w) end
  end
  w.i = last + 1
  if w.i > n then
    w.phase = w.phase + 1
    w.i = 1
  end
  LIVE.sched = true
  local ok = pcall(function() Wait.frames(function() liveStep() end, 1) end)
  if not ok then
    LIVE.sched = false
    LIVE.walk = nil
  end
end

function liveFlushFull()
  if OBS_LIVE_API ~= true then return end
  pcall(function()
    while #LIVE.fulljobs > 0 do liveFullBuildJob(table.remove(LIVE.fulljobs, 1)) end
    LIVE.fullsched = false
  end)
  local url = liveUrl()
  if url == nil then return end
  local seqs = {}
  for sq in pairs(LIVE.full or {}) do seqs[#seqs + 1] = sq end
  table.sort(seqs)
  if #seqs == 0 then return end
  log("RTT live: releasing " .. #seqs .. " full turn(s) to the post-game feed")
  local i = 0
  local function step()
    i = i + 1
    if i > #seqs then return end
    local b = LIVE.full[seqs[i]]
    if b ~= nil then
      pcall(function()
        WebRequest.custom(url, "POST", true, b, { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" }, function() end)
      end)
    end
    pcall(function() Wait.frames(step, 3) end)
  end
  step()
end

function liveBuild()
  LIVE.sched = false
  if OBS_LIVE_API ~= true then LIVE.due = nil return end
  if obsBusy() and LIVE.tries < OBS_TURN_WAIT_MAX then
    LIVE.tries = LIVE.tries + 1
    LIVE.sched = true
    local ok = pcall(function() Wait.frames(function() liveBuild() end, 2) end)
    if not ok then LIVE.sched = false end
    return
  end
  LIVE.tries = 0
  if LIVE.due == nil then return end
  if OBS.id == nil then LIVE.due = nil return end
  local sh = liveSheet()
  if sh == nil then LIVE.due = nil return end
  if LIVE.sending and (os.time() - LIVE.sentat) < OBS_LIVE_STALE then return end
  LIVE.sending = false
  local due = LIVE.due
  LIVE.due = nil
  if LIVE.id ~= OBS.id then liveReset(OBS.id) end
  local turn = due.turn or {}
  if due.trigger == "turn" and turn.source == "turns" then
    local to = tostring(turn.color or "")
    if to == "" or to == LIVE.lastTurn then return end
  end
  local url = liveUrl()
  if url == nil then return end
  LIVE.lastTurn = tostring(turn.color or "")
  local scores = liveScores(sh, LIVE.deck == nil)
  if LIVE.deck == nil and scores.deck ~= nil and scores.deck ~= "" then
    LIVE.deck = scores.deck
    LIVE.lms = scores.landmarks or {}
  end
  local objs = nil
  pcall(function() objs = getAllObjects() end)
  if objs == nil then objs = {} end
  local handSet, handRects, zones, counts = liveNets()
  LIVE.walk = { id = OBS.id, url = url, trigger = due.trigger, turn = turn, scores = scores,
                suits = liveSuitTable(), objs = objs, i = 1, phase = 1, rows = {},
                wh = { hand = 0, hidden = 0, facedown = 0, held = 0 }, markers = {},
                handSet = handSet, handRects = handRects, zones = zones, counts = counts,
                fogSet = {}, fogRects = {} }
  liveStep()
end

local OBS_SEP = "\n~~~\n"

function onSave()
  return ""
end

function onLoad(state)
  obsResetLog()
  pcall(function()
    if type(state) ~= "string" or state == "" then return end
    local sections = {}
    for part in (state .. OBS_SEP):gmatch("(.-)" .. OBS_SEP) do
      local tag = part:match("^(%u+)\n")
      if tag ~= nil then sections[tag] = part:sub(#tag + 2) end
    end
    if sections.HEAD == nil then return end
    local f = {}
    for v in (sections.HEAD .. "\t"):gmatch("(.-)\t") do f[#f + 1] = v end
    if tonumber(f[1]) ~= OBS_STATE_VER then
      log("RTT archive: saved log is version " .. tostring(f[1]) .. ", discarded.")
      return
    end
    OBS.id = (f[2] ~= "" and f[2] or nil)
    if OBS.id == nil then
      log("RTT archive: saved log has no game_id, discarded.")
      obsResetLog()
      return
    end
    OBS.started = tonumber(f[3]) or os.time()
    OBS.carry = tonumber(f[4]) or 0
    OBS.cbase = os.clock()
    OBS.seq = tonumber(f[5]) or 0
    OBS.run = tonumber(f[6]) or 0
    OBS.truncated = (tonumber(f[7]) == 1)
    for line in (sections.OBJ or ""):gmatch("[^\n]+") do
      local g = line:match('^"(%w+)"')
      if g ~= nil then
        OBS.objs[g] = line
        OBS.seen[g] = true
        OBS.bobj = OBS.bobj + #line
      end
    end
    for line in (sections.SEEN or ""):gmatch("[^\n]+") do OBS.seen[line] = true end
    for line in (sections.EV or ""):gmatch("[^\n]+") do
      OBS.ev[#OBS.ev + 1] = line
      OBS.bev = OBS.bev + #line
    end
    for line in (sections.SNAP or ""):gmatch("[^\n]+") do
      OBS.snap[#OBS.snap + 1] = line
      OBS.bsnap = OBS.bsnap + #line
    end
    OBS.full = true
    log("RTT archive: restored game_id " .. tostring(OBS.id) .. ", " .. #OBS.ev .. " events, "
      .. #OBS.snap .. " snapshots.")
  end)
end
